q: How does a Yamunanagar plywood unit count the resin it uses in Scope 3?
title: Yamunanagar plywood: resin in Scope 3
short: Urea formaldehyde and phenolic resins are made from fossil feedstocks, so they carry a real upstream footprint. Multiply kilograms of resin bought by a per kg factor from the supplier or a database, and keep it separate from timber, which is mostly biogenic carbon.
audience: Plywood, block board and veneer units in Yamunanagar and Haryana

ul: Resin purchase invoices in kg, by type.
Urea or formaldehyde bought if you cook resin yourself.
Veneer and timber purchases in cubic metres.

sections.h: If you make resin on site
p: Count the boiler fuel and power for cooking in your own Scope 1 and 2, and the urea and methanol or formaldehyde you buy in Scope 3.
Furniture makers and EU importers ask for footprint per cubic metre. Resin, hot press steam and power usually decide the difference between units.

senseible: Senseible turns supplier invoices into a Scope 3 record with the supplier, quantity and factor behind every figure, so you can see which supplier data is still missing.
